subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: The Bodhi Tree
description: A quick, practical guide to The Bodhi Tree.

hook.text: Siddhartha sat under a fig tree and refused to move until he achieved enlightenment. He became the Buddha.

buildup.text: The Bodhi tree in Bodh Gaya, India, is a descendant of that original tree. Pilgrims visit it after 2,500 years.

discovery.text: The tree is the axis mundi for Buddhism—the point where human suffering meets cosmic wisdom and is overcome.

twist.text: Emperor Ashoka's daughter carried a branch to Sri Lanka. The tree literally traveled and took root in new soil.

climax.text: Unlike Yggdrasil, the Bodhi tree doesn't hold the universe—it changes whoever sits beneath it. The axis is internal.

punchline.text: Sit still long enough. The tree does the rest.

quiz.question: What happened under the Bodhi tree?
